Live learning application . In development

StudyLab

The problem

Students need a place to connect programming and database theory with practical examples, check mistakes and revise independently.

My contribution

I designed and built the lessons, quizzes, pseudocode parser and tracer, flowchart tools, dependency-diagram builder, SQL workspace, automatic SQL answer checks and browser-local progress tracking.

What it delivers

Four learning modules cover Programming Logic and Design, Database Introduction, Intermediate and Advanced. Advanced includes Hadoop, HDFS, YARN, MapReduce and Hive lessons. The SQL workspace provides seven fictional datasets, 52 worked examples and 47 challenges. Students can also use practice exams, printable resources and editable study packs where available.

Technologies and approach

HTML page layouts, CSS and JavaScript modules. SQL runs locally using SQLite compiled to WebAssembly in a worker. Drafts and progress use browser storage; GitHub Actions publishes the static application.

Current status and limits

Live supplementary learning material under active development. Browser SQL compatibility modes are not native SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL connections. Hadoop examples need a separate configured environment. Native server and cluster validation remain pending. Saved progress stays in the same browser profile and does not sync across devices.
